summary: Backend-only first-pass review of RootRecord Business Manager Mobile API. Created pytest suite with 27 tests covering every endpoint listed in the review request (auth + isolation, categories, projects, time/manual, money, clients+invoice math, debts/funds/scheduled/resources, stock, schedule, businesses, settings, feedback, dashboard summary, health, CORS, bearer auth errors). All 27 tests pass against the public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 933 lines — consider splitting into routers/ by domain (auth, time, money, clients, stock, schedule, settings) once the feature set stabilises; not a functional issue but hurts maintainability.
`@app.on_event('startup')` is deprecated in modern FastAPI; prefer lifespan context manager for future-proofing.
No rate limiting or brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login — acceptable for a preview but flag for production parity with the desktop app's trust model.
JWT TTL is 7 days with no refresh-token rotation; acceptable for mobile convenience per spec but document the tradeoff.
Password policy is min_length=6 only — consider adding complexity requirements or zxcvbn scoring in production.
/api/auth/upgrade-pro is an unauthenticated-upgrade demo by design (noted as MOCKED in review request); main agent should gate behind a server-side licence check before going to production.
/api/categories is the only paginated-feeling list; most list endpoints return unbounded documents (`_list` has no limit). Add pagination + limit before data grows.
seed_data_creation: All test data uses TEST_ prefix and is deleted within each test. One test user per session (TEST_user2_<hex>) is left in MongoDB — harmless but can be purged with db.users.deleteMany({email: /^TEST_/}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_rootrecord_api.py is the regression harness. Run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_rootrecord_api.py -v`. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var (falls back to the known preview URL). Covers every route in server.py. Admin seeding is idempotent and fires on backend startup. MOCKED: /api/auth/upgrade-pro (no Stripe).
mocked_apis_verified: /api/auth/upgrade-pro — flips plan=free → pro in Mongo; no licence/Stripe call, as documented
rca of the issue: No issues found. All auth flows (register/login/me/upgrade/401 on missing+bogus tokens), category seed (12 categories sorted, first=Coding), full CRUD for every owned collection, invoice math (subtotal=quantity*unit_price summed correctly), clock-in/clock-out session handling, manual time entries, dashboard aggregation (hours/income/expense/net + breakdown with name+color), health, CORS preflight (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *), and auth isolation (user2 cannot see or delete admin's clients) all verified green.
